tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background (body). The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: cream-deep
tokens.usage: Alternate band background for sections that sit between cream sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text, 2px sticker borders, hard offset shadows and the dark footer ground. 16.5:1 on cream.

tokens.name: body-secondary
tokens.usage: Lede and supporting paragraphs (hero lede, section subtitles). Literal #3a3a3a in the code, not a CSS variable. 10.8:1 on cream.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Small meta text and captions. 5.5:1 on cream, 5.0:1 on cream-deep.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Primary brand hue: hero highlight, btn-red, btn-ink's offset shadow, favicon tile. White on red is 3.1:1, so white text on red passes only at 24px+ (or 19px bold); ink on red is 5.6:1.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Hero eyebrow sticker, btn-yellow, btn-light's offset shadow; on-dark accent in the footer (13.4:1 on ink).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Price/'From $499' sticker and success tags. Ink text only (9.6:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Step and card accent fill (method step 4). Ink text only (7.9:1).

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Section eyebrow label and the header's current-page sticker. Ink text only (9.6:1).

tokens.name: link-on-ink
tokens.usage: Light blue for text and the logo's 'by S3 Labs' on the ink footer (9.8:1). Literal in the code, not a CSS variable.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Sticker and btn-light fill; text on ink and on large red.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: If they can't find you, they'll find another agent.
styles.usage: Hero h1. Code uses clamp(48px, 7vw, 96px); 44px under 900px.

styles.name: cta-title
styles.usage: Contact CTA band headline. Code uses clamp(40px, 5.4vw, 72px).

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section h2. Code uses clamp(36px, 5vw, 64px), max-width 900px.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Pillar card names, method step numbers.

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: Method step and contact path titles.

styles.name: tier
styles.usage: Package tier name. Line height not set in code (inherits); 1.2 assumed.

styles.name: section-sub
styles.usage: Section subtitle under section-title, in body-secondary, max-width 580px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: You own the site and the domain.
styles.usage: Default paragraph and card description text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrow label, uppercase, on lavender.

spacing.note: The code writes spacing as literal px values, not variables. These are the recurring ones.

tokens.name: space-gap-sm
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-gap-md
tokens.usage: Gap between hero stickers and between CTA buttons.

tokens.name: space-gap-lg
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-container-x
tokens.usage: Container side padding (max-width 1280px).

tokens.name: space-head-bottom
tokens.usage: Space under a section header.

tokens.name: space-section-sm
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding on mobile and compact sections.

tokens.name: space-section-lg
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding at desktop.

radius.note: Literal values in the code, not variables.

tokens.name: radius-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring corners.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Section eyebrow and small rectangular stickers ('From $499').

tokens.name: radius-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Hero eyebrow sticker.

tokens.name: radius-card-sm
tokens.usage: Small cards and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-highlight
tokens.usage: Hero highlight block behind 'another agent.'

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Pillar, pricing and template cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and sticker pills.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows, no blur: the sticker look. Usually ink; buttons swap in a brand colour.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Stickers and the section eyebrow at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker-hover
tokens.usage: Sticker hover; hero eyebrow at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: btn-red and btn-yellow at rest (btn-ink uses red, btn-light uses yellow).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the hero highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-button-hover
tokens.usage: Button hover, with translate(-2px, -2px).

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Featured or hovered cards.
